wizard.step1Desc: Where does the data come from? Pick a connection, then choose tables or files to migrate.
wizard.step2Desc: Where should the data land? Confirm the target connection and optionally rename destination tables.
wizard.step3Desc: How should data be written? Not sure? Pick Full Refresh, the safest for first migrations.
wizard.step4Desc: Defaults work fine. Tune these reliability options only if needed.
wizard.step5Desc: Name the job and choose between manual or scheduled runs.
wizard.hint1: Pick a source connection and at least one table
wizard.hint3: Complete the fields required by this mode
wizard.schemaEvoDesc: Add new source columns to the target table automatically
wizard.adjustTypeDesc: Auto-convert mismatched column types, may lose precision
wizard.retryDesc: Retry automatically after failures, up to N attempts
wizard.verifyDesc: Compare source and target row counts when finished
wizard.loadedAtDesc: Append a write-timestamp column for data freshness
wizard.yamlTeaser: View or export the equivalent sling YAML
wizard.sourceTablePlaceholder: Pick a table, or type a file path / SQL
wizard.modeReplaceDesc: Drop & recreate the target table, load everything. Best for first runs.
wizard.modeTruncateDesc: Keep the table, clear rows, load everything.
wizard.modeAppendDesc: Only move rows added since the last run. Needs a timestamp / auto-increment column.
wizard.modeUpsertDesc: Insert new rows, update existing ones (merge by primary key). Needs a primary key.
wizard.modeSnapshotDesc: Full append each run with an automatic loaded-at column.
wizard.primaryKeyHint: Identifies a row. Pick multiple columns to build a composite key
wizard.pkRequired: Smart Upsert needs a primary key
wizard.ukRequired: Append New Rows needs an incremental column
wizard.noKeysFound: No candidate columns detected — type one manually
wizard.schemaEvo: Add new columns automatically on schema change
wizard.scheduleNoneDesc: Trigger manually from the jobs list or run center
wizard.scheduleEveryDesc: Runs automatically on a fixed cadence
wizard.targetAutoCreate: Missing target tables are created automatically
wizard.noConnsYet: No connections yet. Create one on the Connections page first
wizard.wildcardHint: Wildcards (public.*) or sql:select … queries are supported
wizard.pkManualHint: Separate multiple columns with commas (composite key), order matters

mapping.existsDestructiveHint: Target table exists; current mode will overwrite its data
